about: Asks the test command runs (npm run test-asks): each ask with the doodads it should find, best first. The first ones come from the Search Parts of three Doodad Searches (each part asked by its name and by its line); the rest are typical mappers' asks. An ask marked reviewed: false hasn't had its expected ids checked by hand yet. Asks never name a map, campaign or story. The last asks are the typical mappers' asks written in Russian, Korean, Spanish, German, French, Portuguese and Polish, with the expected ids of their English originals; they are unreviewed because the translations aren't checked by native speakers.
